prompt:

Header text verbatim: "nitton". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "nineteen".
Scene: An adult celebrating a nineteenth birthday with exactly two large number candles forming "19" on one cake, friends smiling, no other numerals or extra number candles.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "nitton = nineteen; nio helps recall the first part.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon fyller nitton år i dag.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established card style described in the prompt; no image supplied.
